core_obligations: Reduce to generators (proof lines 5029-5043): it suffices to check the compatibility with pushforward on the standard generators of the Chow groups of the projective bundle, namely the products of powers of the first Chern class of the twist with the pullback of a cycle of the base; the pushforward of those generators is zero except for the top power, where it is the original cycle.

Reduce to a statement about the degree map (proof lines 5043-5055): the cycle class of such a generator is the corresponding power of the Chern class capped with the pullback of the cycle class of the base, so by the projection formula the compatibility with pushforward reduces to the vanishing of the pushforwards of the lower powers of the Chern class and to the pushforward of the top power being the unit.

Verify the degree map (proof lines 5055-5061): equivalently, the degree map of the projective bundle defined by the displayed rules must satisfy the condition in the axiom defining the degree map, which follows from the explicit computation of the class of the diagonal of the projective bundle.
proof_roadmap: Reduce to the standard generators of the Chow groups of the projective bundle.
Use the projection formula to reduce to the pushforwards of powers of the Chern class.
Verify the defining property of the degree map through the class of the diagonal.
difficulty_reason: The lemma proves that for data satisfying the first seven axioms the cycle class map commutes with pushforward along the projectivization of a vector bundle over a nonempty equidimensional base (statement lines 5025-5031). The proof (proof lines 5032-5061) reduces to the standard generators, applies the projection formula, and verifies the condition defining the degree map using the computation of the class of the diagonal of the projective bundle. H3: a three step reduction with a verification through the diagonal class, written out in full.
